name: homestay-management-system
description: SaaS-style Homestay Management System demo. React + Redux-Saga frontend, Express API on Vercel serverless functions, seeded in-memory storage.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @homestay/api" "npm run dev -w @homestay/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @homestay/shared && npm run test -w @homestay/seed-data && npm run test -w @homestay/api && npm run test -w @homestay/web
